title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 44
description: Ten questions on Psalms 44: God's past deeds for the fathers, and Israel's cry when he seems to have rejected them.

questions.text: According to verse 1, who told them what work God did in the days of old?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old."

questions.text: According to verse 3, what gave the fathers the land instead of their own sword?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they didn't get the land by their own sword, but by God's right hand, his arm, and the light of his face.

answers.text: God's right hand and his arm
A peace treaty with the nations
Gold and silver paid to the kings

questions.text: For whom does the psalmist ask God to command victories in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!"

questions.text: In what does the speaker say he will not trust in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "For I will not trust in my bow."

questions.text: For how much does verse 12 say God sells his people?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale."

questions.text: What has God made them among the nations, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says, "You make us a byword among the nations."

questions.text: In verse 19, in what place does the psalmist say God has crushed them?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says, "You have crushed us in the haunt of jackals."

answers.text: In the depths of the sea

questions.text: What does verse 21 say God knows?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says, "For he knows the secrets of the heart."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask the Lord in verse 23?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says, "Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord?"

questions.text: To what is their soul bowed down, according to verse 25?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says, "For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth."
